# Vann Equity Management

> An independent, SEC-registered, GIPS-compliant fiduciary equity-management firm based in Plano and Austin, Texas (founded 2015). Vann Equity Management serves individuals, institutions, endowments, and family offices, combining institutional investment rigor with boutique accountability.

## About
Vann Equity Management, LLC is a fiduciary, fee-based registered investment adviser. The firm manages separately managed equity accounts and tactical asset-allocation portfolios through a disciplined, proprietary, risk-controlled process. The firm has been independently verified under the Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS®) for the periods June 1, 2018 through December 31, 2025.

## Leadership
John A. Vann - Chief Executive Officer, Chief Compliance Officer, and Chairman.
Aaron J. Vann - Partner; leads the firm's proprietary quantitative models and oversees portfolio construction and stock selection for its equity separately managed accounts.

## Strategies (GIPS composites)
- US Large Cap Growth Equity (SMA) — benchmarks: Russell 1000 Growth (TR), S&P 500 (TR)
- US Large Cap Value Equity (SMA) — benchmarks: Russell 1000 Value, S&P 500 (TR)
- International ADR Equity (SMA) — benchmark: MSCI EAFE (TR Net)
- Structured Notes — custom blended benchmark
- Index Advantage Global ETF — benchmark: MSCI ACWI (TR Net)
- Index Advantage International ETF — benchmark: MSCI EAFE (TR Net)
- Index Advantage Small/Mid ETF — benchmark: Russell 2500
- REIT Equity — benchmark: MSCI US REIT Index (grs)

## Performance
GIPS-compliant composite performance, independently verified. Returns are presented gross and net of fees with benchmarks. Full standardized GIPS Composite Report: /gips-report.html. Past performance is not indicative of future results.
